patch_description: Revert the RX layer to full independent per-qubit parameters (as in the best-performing 116-param version) and remove the diameter-connectivity layer that hurt generalization (score dropped from 0.89 to 0.87 when added). Additionally, apply the recommended mixed-axis diversification to the skip-2 entangling layer: keep CRZ on even skip edges (crz_skip_even) but switch odd skip edges to CRY (cry_skip_odd), echoing the mixed-axis success pattern from earlier high-scoring generations. This restores the proven backbone while adding rotation-axis diversity along long-range connections without increasing depth or gate count beyond the best baseline.
